name: Numbuh 202
source:
Name: Kimberly Schmidt

Designation: Numbuh 202

Sector: G

Postion: Sector Leader/ 2x4 Technology Officer


Numbuh 202 loves her job, her team, pretty much everything, but more than anything she loves inventing, which is great...if her inventions didn't have a tendency to blow up, or attempt global domination.

She's easily excitable, adaptive and always ready to help (and maybe a teensy bit competitive.)


"Ya build a sentient robot one time...it was supposed to play hopscotch with me! Not try to launch a missile! I said I was sorry!"
